archive_name: Concordia Historical Institute (Lutheran Church-Missouri Synod Archives), Saint Louis, MO
notes: ArchivesSpace public interface. Enumerated (a) the 'School yearbooks' subject index (/subjects/960) - the authoritative list of all yearbook-holding series; (b) the top-level children of the two Missouri geographic collections (resources/3340 Saint Louis, 97 nodes; resources/3339 Missouri, 92 nodes) via /tree/root JSON; (c) targeted keyword/title searches per seed school. ArchivesSpace /tree/node and /tree/waypoint endpoints return HTTP 500 server-side, so deeper series expansion was not possible; per-school keyword searches were run as a compensating sweep.
